links.outcome: Ophthalmologist-rated quality of VLLM diagnostic descriptions of retinal images
links.effect: Only 21.2% of GPT-4V default, 4.8% of GPT-4V data analyst and 28.6% of Gemini responses rated good; all VLLMs inadequate for accurate diagnosis despite 97.1% detection by GPT-4V default.
links.quote: Despite the relatively high detection rates, the quality of diagnostic descriptions was generally suboptimal-with only 21.2% of GPT-4V's (default) responses, 4.8% of GPT-4V's (data analyst) responses and 28.6% for Google Gemini's responses rated as good.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic and detection performance of off-the-shelf multimodal foundation models (GPT-4V, Google Gemini) on a benchmark dataset of 44 retinal photographs without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
